mkp-diagrams:layers@1.name: layers
mkp-diagrams:layers@1.about: A layered diagram's rows (or, left to right, its columns) of node cards, lanes and labels, and its lines, square-routed through the lanes.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.about: the cells of each row, from route

inputs.name: cards
inputs.about: every node, looked up and lit

inputs.name: lines
inputs.about: every line

inputs.name: groups
inputs.about: the boxes that nodes sit in, by id

inputs.name: hot
inputs.about: the label cells of lit lines, drawn in the info tone

inputs.name: faded
inputs.about: the label cells of faded lines

inputs.name: pick
inputs.about: the caller's chosen node, by place; -1 for none

value.expr: fold(cards, {}, (d, c) => if(c.group != "", put(d, c.id, c.group), d))

comment: rows well apart, as a chart is read: a line between them is long enough to follow

inputs.name: pad
inputs.about: inner padding

inputs.name: gap
inputs.about: space between children

inputs.name: align
inputs.about: cross-axis alignment

inputs.name: fill
inputs.about: background

inputs.name: tint
inputs.about: a wash of this colour behind it: a state, not a surface

inputs.name: stroke
inputs.about: border

inputs.name: line
inputs.about: the border's line

inputs.name: radius
inputs.about: corner radius

inputs.name: dim
inputs.about: faded back, while something else is in focus

inputs.name: blur
inputs.about: blurred past reading, until it is revealed

core:text@1.name: text
core:text@1.about: A styled run of inline Markdown with inline maths.

inputs.name: lines
inputs.about: height kept for this many lines, so a shorter text moves nothing below it

inputs.name: literal
inputs.about: show the value as it is, not read as inline Markdown

inputs.name: caps
inputs.about: in spaced capitals: a caption or a label over a column

core:flex@1.name: flex
core:flex@1.about: Children in a row that wraps or scrolls.

inputs.name: line

inputs.name: dim
inputs.about: faded back, while something else is in focus

inputs.name: blur
inputs.about: blurred past reading, until it is revealed

mkp-diagrams:gnode@1.name: gnode
mkp-diagrams:gnode@1.about: A node card the reader can press: pressing it says so (picked, with its place), and the caller chooses it, or lets it go if it was chosen.

inputs.name: node
inputs.about: the node, as gcard takes it

mkp-diagrams:gcard@1.name: gcard
mkp-diagrams:gcard@1.about: One node of a diagram as a compact card: an icon tile in its tone, a bold label and a note in small capitals; lit (outlined and washed in info) when it is chosen, faded back when another is.

inputs.name: node
inputs.about: the node and its look (card), its place in the order the bar steps through (k), and how it is lit: on, chosen; near, next to the chosen one; off, faded back; empty, nothing is chosen

values.name: hue
values.body: if(t == "info", info, if(t == "ok", ok, if(t == "warn", warn, if(t == "bad", bad, if(t == "accent" or t == "thm", accent, muted)))))
comment: a tone's colour; "accent" (or "thm") is the theme's own, anything else is neutral

values.name: dashes
comment: an input or output, and a label, are drawn dashed

values.name: wash
values.body: if(lit, info, if(round and node.tone == "", muted, surface))

values.name: tilewash
comment: a lit card is washed in info already: its tile stands out from it on the surface
a sub-process: the card inside a second outline

local:mkp-diagrams:gcard@1:hue#0.name: hue
local:mkp-diagrams:gcard@1:hue#0.src: if(t == "info", info, if(t == "ok", ok, if(t == "warn", warn, if(t == "bad", bad, if(t == "accent" or t == "thm", accent, muted)))))

local:mkp-diagrams:gcard@1:wash#0.name: wash
local:mkp-diagrams:gcard@1:wash#0.src: if(lit, info, if(round and node.tone == "", muted, surface))

mkp-diagrams:glyph@1.name: glyph
mkp-diagrams:glyph@1.about: A node's icon tile: a small rounded square with a soft wash, the icon in its tone, named as text so data can name it. A name the icon set doesn't have shows a square.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: an icon's name

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: the icon's colour

inputs.name: wash
inputs.about: the tile's

inputs.name: round
inputs.about: a round tile, for a pill-shaped node

comment: written as an expression: mkp fmt prints a plain name=info as the bare word info, which

core:icon@1.name: icon
core:icon@1.about: A symbol from a fixed set, drawn in the provider's own icon style.

inputs.name: tone
inputs.about: its colour; none: the text's

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: what it means, when it stands for words

core:press@1.name: press
core:press@1.about: Anything clickable and focusable: a button, a tab, an option among others, an on/off toggle or switch, an answer row with a tick (check) or a dot (radio), or its content itself, such as a card (plain).

inputs.name: label
inputs.about: accessible name when the content has no text

inputs.name: emphasis
inputs.about: how much it stands out: low for one of a row of quiet buttons, high for the one to press

inputs.name: mark
inputs.about: an answer row's letter (A, B, C), shown in its tick or dot until it is chosen

mkp-diagrams:blocks#0.name: blocks
mkp-diagrams:blocks#0.src: map(filter(range(0, len(row) - 1), j => indexof(map(row, x => grp(x, gof)), grp(row[j], gof)) == j), j => {id: "~b~" + row[j].id, group: grp(row[j], gof), cells: filter(row, c => grp(c, gof) == grp(row[j], gof))})

mkp-diagrams:grp#0.name: grp
mkp-diagrams:grp#0.src: if(c.kind == "node" and get(gof, c.id, "") != "", get(gof, c.id, ""), "~" + c.id)
